# LaunchDarkly

A feature management platform that helps teams build better software faster using feature flags.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/launch-darkly/.

## Actions

- **Create Flag Trigger Workflow**: Create a flag trigger workflow.
- **Delete Trigger Workflow**: Delete a specific flag trigger workflow.
- **Get Custom Roles**: Retrieve a list of all custom roles.
- **Get Environments**: Retrieve a list of all environments within a project.
- **List Code Reference Repositories**: List code reference repositories.
- **List Projects**: Retrieve a list of all projects.
- **List Teams**: List all teams in launchdarkly.
